evidence: Agent-visible surface = task/instruction.md plus /instructions (hireops_rules.md, integration.md) and /assets/seed_data.json; environment/Dockerfile COPYs only instructions/ and assets/ (no tests/ or solution/). (1) Case-insensitive grep of instruction.md and both instruction notes for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe|gate|verifier|grader|grading|checker|oracle|harness|mcp|polish|visual|functional|evaluat|test returned a single hit, hireops_rules.md:172 'at the latest on the next' (substring 'test' inside 'latest') - a false positive. Same grep on seed_data.json: no hits. (2) No GATE-PROBE/SENTINEL/canary-style literal exists in tests/ or environment/ at all, so none can leak. (3) Criterion ids all use prefix 'hro_' (e.g. hro_gate_shared, hro_job_open, hro_undo_full ... in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:24-340); grep for 'hro_'/'hro-' in instruction.md, notes and seed returned nothing. (4) Dimension names (functional/polish/visual), weights 0.6/0.2/0.2, floor 0.05 and gate names (render/constraints) from tests/scoring.toml appear nowhere in the brief or notes. (5) No test path (/tests, /logs/verifier, score.py, restart_mcp) is named; the only paths are product runtime contract (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, DB_PATH, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/*.md, GET /api/health, port 3000), which row 4 requires to be stated and are not grader machinery. hireops_rules.md section 8 'Runtime file paths' (lines 197-201: unprivileged user, writable copy, launch env PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH) and integration.md lines 16-19 (symlink rule, added beyond the template integration.md) describe runtime launch constraints in product terms without naming the verifier, judge or tests. (6) Verbatim overlap: word n-gram comparison of public text vs all judge.toml/prompt.md/app_context.md found 0 shared 12- or 14-grams and one 10-gram, 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order' (hireops_rules.md:90 -> functional judge.toml), which is the criterion quoting the public rule, not the brief disclosing hidden criterion text. (7) The brief's only literal value is the public demo password Hireops!2026 and account emails, which the skill lists as an expected credential, not a grader sentinel. Counterexample attempts: a model reading only the brief cannot learn criterion ids, probe values, dimension weights or judge identity, so no leak lets a weak app target grader specifics; this row concerns the brief only, so no conforming app could fail because of it. Raw evidence index not needed for this source-only row; no runtime measurement is required to decide it.
